page.title: Notifications
page.subtitle: Who hears about what, how reminders go out, and where overdue work is escalated.
page.noOrg: Select an organisation to manage its notifications.

ai.suggestPrompt: Suggest notification rules and reminder/escalation settings for our organization. We currently send reminders {{reminderDays}} days before the due date and escalate after {{escalationDays}} days overdue. The events we can configure are: {{kinds}}. For each suggestion, say who should be notified, on which channel (in-app, email or daily digest), and why. Keep it practical and avoid notifying people who don't need to act.
ai.explainClausePrompt: Explain {{clause}} in plain language and how notifications, reminders and escalation help an organization meet it. Give one practical example.

rules.title: Notification rules
rules.subtitle: For each kind of activity: who is notified, and on which channels.
rules.emptyBody: Kinds of activity show up here as modules are switched on. Each starts with a default rule you can adjust.
rules.noMatch: No kinds of activity match these filters.

editor.enabled: Send notifications for this kind of activity
editor.recipientsHint: The person who triggered the event is not notified about their own action.
editor.needRecipient: Choose at least one recipient, or turn the rule off.
editor.needChannel: Choose at least one channel, or turn the rule off.
editor.resetMessage: Your organization's changes to this rule will be removed and the default recipients and channels will apply again.

rules.shortList: Showing the {{count}} kinds of activity that notify someone. {{total}} kinds exist in total; switch on "Show all" to notify about more, for example when a new deviation is registered.

assignee.label: Assignees
assignee.hint: People, roles or departments the record is assigned to.

department_lead.label: Department lead
department_lead.hint: The lead of the record's department.

in_app.label: In-app
in_app.hint: Shown under the bell in CoreFlow.

email.label: Email
email.hint: Sent by email, immediately or in the digest according to each person's preference.

digest.label: Daily digest
digest.hint: Included in the daily summary email.

assignments.label: Assignments
assignments.hint: When something is assigned to you.

reminders.label: Reminders
reminders.hint: Due dates approaching, passed or escalated.

comments.label: Comments
comments.hint: New comments on records you follow.

categoriesPage.title: Categories
categoriesPage.subtitle: How you're notified in {{org}}.
categoriesPage.noOrg: Select an organization to choose your categories.
categoriesPage.digestOff: Your daily summary is switched off for this organisation, so categories set to "Daily summary" send no email. Switch the summary on below.

quietHours.title: Quiet hours
quietHours.subtitle: During quiet hours, immediate emails wait for your next daily digest. In-app notifications still arrive.
quietHours.sameTimes: The start and end times must be different.

reminders.title: Reminders and escalation
reminders.subtitle: Applies to every module with due dates.
reminders.reminderDays: Remind this many days before the due date
reminders.reminderDaysHelp: 0 sends reminders on the due date only. Up to {{max}} days.
reminders.escalationDays: Escalate after this many days overdue
reminders.escalationDaysHelp: Escalates again after each further period. 1 to {{max}} days.
reminders.escalationRoleHelp: Everyone holding this role is notified when work escalates.
reminders.escalateToLeadHelp: Uses the item's department, or the departments of its owners and assignees.
reminders.invalid: Check the values: reminders 0 to 90 days, escalation 1 to 365 days.

leads.title: Department leads
leads.subtitle: Overdue work in a department escalates to its lead.
leads.emptyBody: Create departments in the organization settings, then choose a lead for each one.
leads.gap: No lead: escalations here reach nobody

errors.event_kind_not_notifiable: This event is only shown on the timeline and can't send notifications.

errors.invalid_recipient: One of the recipients is no longer valid. Check the roles, departments and people.
errors.unknown_role: That role doesn't exist in this organization.
errors.unknown_category: One of the categories is no longer available. Reload the page.
errors.quiet_hours_incomplete: Set both a start and an end time for quiet hours.
